title: Lena and the Safehouse
author: Yara Sterling
blurb: Elodie Kavanagh, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
